sources.verbatim_excerpt: The first AI Factories will represent a €1.5 billion investment, combining national and EU funding.
The European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) has selected six additional Artificial Intelligence (AI) Factories in the EU.
This brings the total to 19 AI Factories across 16 Member States.
